name: 11020 · Great Neck, NY
findings: ZIP 11020 (Great Neck) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11020 (Great Neck) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 11020 (Great Neck) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 37% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
